summary: Frontend retest for the 'ho settato la password master ma poi non posso fare il login' bug. All three critical flows PASS: (1) Setup with TestPass123 redirects to /home ✅ (2) After page refresh, user lands on /login (NOT /setup) since master password is already set ✅ (3) Login with TestPass123 authenticates and redirects to /home ✅. The isCheckingSetup loading state + retry logic in AuthContext successfully prevents premature redirect. Also verified that navigating to root '/' after auth state loss correctly routes to /login screen. Database was reset via mongosh before test to ensure clean state.

action_items: No fixes required for the reported bug - all flows verified working.

critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.checkSetup retry logic (3x with 300ms) + isCheckingSetup loading gate in index.tsx correctly resolves the race condition where <Redirect /> fired before is_setup was resolved. Implementation is sound.
index.tsx returns ActivityIndicator only while isCheckingSetup=true — good UX guard.
seed_data_creation: Reset MongoDB collections users and password_entries via mongosh, then created new master password 'TestPass123' via UI setup flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master password is currently set to 'TestPass123'. Backend /api/auth/check returns {is_setup: true}. To retest setup flow, first reset DB with: mongosh --eval 'use("test_database"); db.users.deleteMany({}); db.password_entries.deleteMany({});'. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Public URL: https://password-vault-167.preview.emergentagent.com. API endpoint for setup-status is /api/auth/check (not /api/auth/setup-status).
rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA: In previous iteration, index.tsx rendered <Redirect href='/setup' /> synchronously on first render before AuthContext.checkSetup() finished (React 19 StrictMode double-mount + fetch abort). Fix: Added isCheckingSetup=true default in AuthContext, only set to false after initializeAuth completes. checkSetup now retries 3x with 300ms backoff to survive StrictMode abort. index.tsx shows ActivityIndicator while isCheckingSetup, gating the redirect. Verified: after setup and refresh, user now lands on /login as expected.
